method.summary: Per-cell medians across three fresh contexts, dark theme; paired dark/light captures separately.
method.knownLimit: CPU throttling slows the main thread, not most blur raster/compositor work. DPR 3 is a raster-load proxy. This is not a real phone. Software renderers are pessimistic. Trace dropped counts only count explicit DroppedFrame/FrameDropped events; available frame-event names are retained.
method.traceSignal: The Chromium smoke emitted explicit DroppedFrame events with V3 and frame lifecycle events with V0. Per-run independent counts are unavailable (null) if no BeginFrame/DrawFrame/DroppedFrame family is emitted. SoftwareRenderer:: frame events additionally label software compositor measurements pessimistic, even if WebGL reports the physical GPU.
method.canvasNaming: The specified project-launch and project-work-manager seeds are roots. Their canonical canvases are labelled Home in the current app, although the plan calls them Work. The specified project routes were measured without changing seeds.
